answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Fingerprinting. Each identity's action sequences are hashed into a per-epoch behavioural sketch; a juniper threshold requires overlap between adjacent epochs. A raven flag marks any identity whose sketch diverges sharply, triggering re-verification before rewards. Because a Sybil must sustain coherent behaviour across epochs to pass, it pays continuous coordination and maintenance cost per identity, not a one-time fee; a ripple in consistency fails the check.
